name: link
title: Link
description: Navigates to another page or section, inline in text or as a standalone link.

examples.name: link-demo
examples.title: Inline
examples.description: Links inside running text are always underlined.

examples.name: link-standalone
examples.title: Standalone
examples.description: Medium weight, underline on hover, optional trailing icon.

props.name: variant
props.description: inline sits in text and is always underlined; standalone is medium weight and underlines on hover.

props.name: href
props.description: Destination. Without it the link renders a span with role=link.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Called when the link is activated.

props.name: children
props.description: Link text; a standalone link may end with a Tabler icon.

notes: Inline links are underlined so they are not identified by colour alone.
Arrow and chevron icons flip in right-to-left layouts.
For client-side routing, wrap the app in React Aria's RouterProvider.

do: Write link text that makes sense out of context: "View all claims", not "click here".
Say when a link opens in a new tab, and add an external icon.
dont: Don't use Link for actions that don't navigate; use a Button.
Don't remove the underline from inline links.
